Name: Binnui
Summary: A Levite who sealed the covenant, repaired the wall, and is named as father of Noadiah.
KeyVerses: Ezra 8:33; Ezra 10:30; Ezra 10:38; Nehemiah 3:24; Nehemiah 7:15; Nehemiah 10:9; Nehemiah 12:8
LifeLesson: One man's service can span treasure, wall, and covenant.
RelatedEvents: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall; Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
